summary: Replace manual Todoist token flow with the official authenticated CLI
description: Install and integrate the official td CLI: browser OAuth in macOS Keychain, exact structured task creation, bounded subprocess execution, redacted failures, preserved reconciliation, and non-blocking Raycast notifications. Remove the custom API-token runtime path.
acceptance: The production capture path invokes the official td CLI and never reads or accepts a manual API token.
td authentication uses browser OAuth and OS credential storage; subprocesses are bounded and all surfaced failures are redacted.
Task content, exact message link, mail label, no implicit due date, reconciliation, and non-blocking Raycast feedback remain covered by tests.

review_history.evidence: Independent hardening readback: acceptance evidence is present, make check is green, public-data boundary passes, and the final architecture safely supersedes earlier direct-token/API internals where applicable.
